reproduction.command: Run Validator(settings).baseline(case) and Validator(settings).run_application(case, sha) from a Python 3.11 process configured with the disposable Superset checkout and interpreter.
reproduction.environment: disposable local Superset checkout with Python 3.11 and allow_local_validation=true

limitations: The PASS result is a source-backed known reference fix, not a live Devin result.
No Devin API session or remote mutation was performed for this evidence.
